title: The Secret to Reliable UI Automation

scenes.line1: Why do UI tests break so often?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your UI tests fail randomly, even when the app looks fine? Let’s solve the biggest cause of flakiness.

scenes.label: Locator
scenes.sub: Locators target UI elements for automation.
scenes.say: Locators are how your tests find buttons, fields, and links on the screen. Get them wrong, and your tests crumble.
The best selectors use IDs, custom data attributes, or accessible roles. Avoid dynamic classes or nth-child—they break when the UI shifts.
Playwright and Cypress auto-wait for elements, making tests more stable. Selenium needs explicit waits, which can be tricky and cause flakiness if missed.

scenes.question: Should you use nth-child for selectors?
scenes.right: No, nth-child is fragile; use stable IDs or data attributes instead.
scenes.say: In interviews, don’t say you use nth-child or dynamic classes. Those selectors break easily. Always go for stable attributes.
